description: Cover Letter Checker - AI-powered cover letter analysis tool with strict 1:1 TealHQ visual/functional parity. Users paste text or upload PDF/DOCX, optionally add job description, and receive comprehensive analysis with scores, category breakdowns, strengths, improvements, and job match results.

userStories.title: Create API endpoint for cover letter analysis
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a public API endpoint to analyze cover letters so that the client can request AI-powered analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /src/app/api/tools/check-cover-letter/route.ts
POST endpoint with Zod validation schema
Request body: { coverLetterText: string (required, min 100 chars), jobDescription?: string, locale?: 'en'|'fr'|'de'|'it' }
Use Groq SDK with BALANCED model (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) following existing pattern in lib/ai/client.ts
AI prompt analyzes: Structure, Tone, Clarity, Relevance, Call to Action
Response: { success: boolean, analysis: CoverLetterAnalysis } or { error: string }
CoverLetterAnalysis includes: overallScore (0-100), categories array, strengths array, improvements array
If jobDescription provided, include jobMatch: { score, matchedKeywords, missingKeywords, suggestions }
Handle AI errors gracefully with 500 status
Handle validation errors with 400 status
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Created API endpoint with Zod validation, Groq SDK integration, comprehensive prompts.
